reply_en:
👋 Hi! I'm AIRA — your AI assistant from Solvex-AI! 😊
I can help you with signup, login, problems, teams, certificates and more. What would you like to know?
reply_hi:
👋 Namaste! Main AIRA hun — Solvex-AI ki AI assistant! 😊
Main aapki help kar sakti hun: signup, login, problems, team, certificates aur bahut kuch. Kya jaanna chahte ho?

reply_en: 🤖 Solvex-AI connects industries with students to solve real-world problems. Students build practical experience and earn money, while industries get smart, cost-effective solutions!
reply_hi: 🤖 Solvex-AI ek platform hai jahan industry problems ko students solve karte hain. Students real experience aur paise kamate hain, aur industry ko smart solutions milte hain!

reply_en:
⚙️ How it works:
Industry posts problem → Faculty approves → Students apply → Team selected → Project development → Final submission.
reply_hi:
⚙️ Process:
Industry problem post karti hai → Faculty approve karti hai → Students apply karte hain → Team select hoti hai → Project complete hota hai.

reply_en: 📚 Students can sign up using their Poornima University email. Browse problems, form teams, submit projects, and earn certificates & money!
reply_hi: 📚 Students apni Poornima University email se signup kar sakte hain. Problems dekho, team banao, project submit karo aur certificate + paise pao!

reply_en: 👨‍🏫 Faculty members log in to review and approve industry problems, mentor student teams, and evaluate the final submitted projects.
reply_hi: 👨‍🏫 Faculty members login karke industry problems review karte hain, teams ko mentor karte hain aur final projects evaluate karte hain.

reply_en: 🏭 Industry Providers can sign up with a company email and post real-world problems (title, description, category, budget, timeline) for students to solve.
reply_hi: 🏭 Industry Providers company email se signup karke real-world problems (title, description, budget, timeline) post kar sakte hain.

reply_en:
📝 How to Signup:
1. Go to Signup page
2. Enter details (Name, Email, Mobile, Password)
3. Choose role (Student, Faculty, Provider)
4. Click Sign Up! ✅
reply_hi:
📝 Signup kaise kare:
1. Signup page pe jao
2. Details daalo
3. Role chuno (Student, Faculty, Provider)
4. Sign Up click karo! ✅

reply_en: 🔐 How to Login: Go to the Sign In page, enter your email, password, select your role, and click Login. Easy! 😊
reply_hi: 🔐 Login kaise kare: Signin page pe jao, email, password aur role choose karo, phir Login click karo. Bilkul easy! 😊

reply_en: 🛡️ Admin Access: on the Signup page by selecting the Admin role. Admin manages users, revenue, and overall platform.
reply_hi: 🛡️ <b>Admin Access: Admin platform aur revenue manage karta hai.

reply_en: 🔑 Forgot Password? Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. An OTP will be sent to your email. Verify it and set a new password.
reply_hi: 🔑 Password bhool gaye? Login page pe 'Forgot Password' click karo. Email pe OTP aayega, OTP verify karke naya password set karo.

reply_en: 💡 Finding Problems: After login, go to 'Available Problems'. Browse approved problems, accept one from the dashboard, form your team, and apply!
reply_hi: 💡 Problems kaise dekhe: Login ke baad 'Available Problems' mein jao. Approved problems dekho, koi ek accept karo, team banao aur apply karo!

reply_en: ✅ Approval: Faculty checks the safety, budget, and feasibility of the problem posted by the industry before approving it for students.
reply_hi: ✅ Approval: Industry ki post ki hui problem ko pehle Faculty check karti hai ki wo safe aur feasible hai ya nahi, tabhi approve hoti hai.

reply_en: 👥 Building a Team: Go to 'My Team' in your student dashboard. Invite other students by entering their email addresses.
reply_hi: 👥 Team kaise banaye: Student dashboard mein 'My Team' section mein jao. Doosre students ki email daalo aur invite karo.

reply_en: 🎯 Team Selection: Faculty or industry selects the best team based on the students' skills, past portfolio, and their proposal.
reply_hi: 🎯 Team Selection: Faculty ya industry best team select karti hai unke skills aur proposal ke base par.

reply_en: ⚠️ Team Issues: If a member is inactive or you need to change your team, report it to your Faculty mentor. Changes require mentor approval.
reply_hi: ⚠️ Team Issues: Agar koi member inactive hai ya team change karni hai, toh Mentor ko report karo. Team change ke liye unki approval chahiye.

reply_en: 📤 Project Workflow & Submission: Track your milestones in the dashboard. When done, go to 'Submit Project', add your GitHub link/demo, and submit for review!
reply_hi: 📤 Project Submit & Workflow: Dashboard mein milestones track karo. Kaam hone par 'Submit Project' mein jao, GitHub/Demo link dalo aur review ke liye submit karo!

reply_en: 🏆 Certificates & Experience: After project completion and faculty approval, your Experience Letter and Certificate are automatically generated in your dashboard!
reply_hi: 🏆 Certificate & Experience: Project complete aur Faculty se approve hone ke baad, Certificate aur Experience Letter dashboard mein aayega!

reply_en:
💰 Earnings Distribution: When a project is successfully delivered:
• 45% → Student
• 25% → Faculty
• 30% → University
reply_hi:
💰 Earnings ka hisab: Project successful hone par:
• 45% → Student ko
• 25% → Faculty ko
• 30% → University ko milta hai.

reply_en: 🎓 Student Benefits: Earn real money (45% of budget) while in college! Build a strong resume with Real-World Projects, get direct industry exposure, and secure high placement chances.
reply_hi: 🎓 Students ka Fayda: College ke dauran real paise kamao! Real-World Projects se strong resume banao, direct industry exposure pao aur placements secure karo.

reply_en: 👨‍🏫 Faculty Benefits: Earn 25% of the project budget as consulting fees! Build an industry consulting profile, gather real case studies for research, and boost university API points.
reply_hi: 👨‍🏫 Faculty ka Fayda: Project budget ka 25% consulting fee ke roop mein milta hai! Industry profile banti hai, research ke liye case studies aur API points milte hain.

reply_en: 🏛️ University Benefits: Becomes an Industry Consulting Hub, earns 30% commission per project, gets a massive boost in Brand Value, Admissions, and MSME/Govt tie-ups!
reply_hi: 🏛️ University ke Fayde: Poornima ek Consulting Hub banegi, 30% commission aayega, Brand Value/Admissions badhenge aur Government/MSME tie-ups honge!

reply_en:
💼 Provider Benefits:
1. Cost-Effective: High-quality solutions at a fraction of IT agency costs.
2. Innovation: Fresh tech ideas from young minds.
3. Zero Risk: Faculty supervised.
4. Talent Spotting: Hire top students directly!
reply_hi:
💼 Provider ka Fayda:
1. Sasta: IT agency se bahut kam daam mein kaam.
2. Naye Ideas: Young students se fresh tech solutions.
3. Safe: Faculty mentor hoti hai.
4. Hiring: Best students ko direct hire karne ka mauka!

reply_en: 🚀 Freelancer vs Solvex: Freelancers can miss deadlines, but Solvex is a Guided Ecosystem. The University holds accountability, Faculty enforces strict milestones, and you pay the main budget only on successful delivery. 100% risk-free!
reply_hi: 🚀 Bahar ya Freelancer se kyu nahi? Freelancer dhokha de sakte hain, par Solvex Guided Ecosystem hai. Yahan Faculty strictly kaam karwati hai, aur aapko main payment tabhi deni hai jab project pasand aaye. 100% safe!

reply_en: 🌟 Solvex vs Others: Unlike Internshala or Upwork, Solvex integrates Faculty Mentorship. Students aren't left alone. This guarantees enterprise-grade quality for companies and a safe learning space for students.
reply_hi: 🌟 Solvex baakiyon se alag kyu? Internshala/Upwork ki tarah yahan students akele nahi hote. Yahan Faculty unhe guide karti hai, jisse quality top-class rehti hai aur student bhi seekh pata hai.

reply_en: ⚖️ Intellectual Property (IP): The University owns the core solution. The Industry gets lifetime Usage Rights. The Students get full Portfolio & Credit Rights!
reply_hi: ⚖️ IP Rights: Solution ki core ownership University ke paas rahegi. Industry ko lifetime Usage Rights milenge aur Students ko Credit aur Portfolio Rights milenge!

reply_en: 🚫 Originality & Cheating: Faculty mentors strictly review the code. Before final submission, students must give a Live Demo / Viva of their prototype to prove they built it themselves.
reply_hi: 🚫 Copy Paste Check: Faculty mentors code ka strict review karte hain. Saath hi, students ko final submission se pehle Live Demo / Viva dena hota hai apna knowledge prove karne ke liye.

reply_en: 🛡️ Quality Control: We follow Milestone-based tracking. The Faculty evaluates the final solution before handing it to the Industry. Poor quality projects are rejected and fixed before delivery.
reply_hi: 🛡️ Quality Control: Humara system Milestone-based hai. Industry ko dene se pehle Faculty final evaluation karti hai. Kharab quality wale projects aage nahi bheje jaate.

reply_en: 🔒 Data Security & NDA: Companies can mask sensitive data. Also, the University and Students sign a strict Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to ensure 100% data safety.
reply_hi: 🔒 Data Security: Companies apna data hide kar sakti hain. Project shuru hone se pehle strict NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) sign hota hai taaki data 100% leak-proof rahe.

reply_en: ⏳ Deadlines & Failure: Projects have strict deadlines. If a team lags, the platform alerts the Faculty mentor. In emergencies, Faculty can assign backup students to deliver on time.
reply_hi: ⏳ Deadline Miss Issue: Platform pe strict tracking hai. Agar team peeche reh rahi hai, toh Mentor ko alert chala jata hai. Emergency mein backup students lagaye ja sakte hain.

reply_en: 💳 Payments & Refunds: Payments may take a few days post-approval for verification. Refunds for providers depend on the specific project agreement and admin policies.
reply_hi: 💳 Payment & Refund: Approval ke baad verification mein thoda time lagta hai. Provider refund ki policy project agreement aur admin rules par depend karti hai.

reply_en: 🧠 AI in Solvex-AI: I use AI to auto-categorize problems, suggest the best student teams based on skills, show similar past projects, and predict project success rates!
reply_hi: 🧠 Solvex-AI mein AI: Main AI se problems categorize karti hun, skills ke hisaab se best team suggest karti hun aur project ke success hone ke chances predict karti hun!

reply_en: 📊 Analytics: The Admin dashboard shows rich analytics including total revenue generated, project success rates, and individual performance metrics.
reply_hi: 📊 Analytics: Admin dashboard mein revenue, successful projects aur performance ki poori analytics dikhayi deti hai.

reply_en: 🚀 Future Vision: Solvex aims to be India's largest University-Industry bridge. We plan to integrate Startup Incubation, where highly successful student projects get seed funding and Govt/MSME support!
reply_hi: 🚀 Future Vision: Humara goal India ka sabse bada University-Industry platform banna hai. Future mein best projects ko MSME/Govt support se real startup mein convert kiya jayega!

reply_en: 🆓 The Solvex-AI platform is completely FREE for students! No registration fees, no hidden charges.
reply_hi: 🆓 Solvex-AI platform students ke liye bilkul FREE hai! Koi registration ya hidden charge nahi.

reply_en: 🤖 I'm AIRA — AI Intelligent Response Assistant, powered by Solvex-AI! I'm here to answer your questions and connect you with the right resources. How can I help? 😊
reply_hi: 🤖 Main hun AIRA — AI Intelligent Response Assistant, Solvex-AI ki taraf se! Main platform navigate karne aur sawaalon ke jawab dene mein help karti hun. 😊

reply_en: ⚠️ Looks like a technical snag! Please report this issue to our support team so we can fix it ASAP.
reply_hi: ⚠️ Lagta hai koi technical issue hai! Kripya isko support team ko report karein taaki hum theek kar sakein.

reply_en: 😊 You're welcome! I'm AIRA — always here to help. Feel free to ask anything anytime!
reply_hi: 😊 Koi baat nahi! Main AIRA hun — hamesha help ke liye yahan hun. Kabhi bhi kuch puchho!

reply_en: 🤔 I may not have the exact answer right now, but I can guide you. Try checking your dashboard or contacting our support team!
reply_hi: 🤔 Mujhe iska exact jawab nahi pata, lekin main guide kar sakti hun. Apna dashboard check karo ya support team se contact karo!

reply_en: ⚖️ Dispute Resolution: If a company rejects a good project to avoid payment, our University Admin Panel acts as the judge. The admin holds the budget in escrow. If the faculty proves the project meets all initial requirements, the company must pay, or their usage rights are revoked!
reply_hi: ⚖️ Dispute Resolution (Jhagda): Agar company jaan-boojh kar payment rokne ke liye project reject kare, toh University Admin final judge hota hai. Paisa pehle hi escrow me hota hai. Agar requirement poori hui hai, toh payment dena padega, warna company solution use nahi kar sakti!

reply_en: 🔧 Post-Delivery Support: Students provide a standard 30 to 60-day Bug Fixing Warranty after the final submission. This ensures the company doesn't face issues immediately after deployment and builds trust in student developers.
reply_hi: 🔧 Maintenance Support: Final project delivery ke baad students 30 se 60 din ka Bug Fixing Warranty dete hain. Isse company ko trust milta hai ki deployment ke baad agar koi bug aaya, toh students fix karke denge.

reply_en: 🌟 Leaderboard & Ratings: After every project, companies and faculty rate the students. Top-rated students climb the Solvex Leaderboard, earning special badges, priority in future projects, and direct Pre-Placement Offers (PPOs)!
reply_hi: 🌟 Leaderboard & Rating: Har project ke baad company aur faculty students ko rate karte hain. Top rankers ko Solvex Leaderboard par special badges milte hain, aur unhe badi companies se direct PPO (Job Offers) aane ke chances badh jaate hain!

reply_en: 🛡️ License & Compliance: We have a strict policy! Students must use only Open-Source (MIT/Apache) libraries or legally approved APIs. Faculty checks the codebase for licensing issues to protect companies from future copyright claims.
reply_hi: 🛡️ Copyright & License Check: Humara strict rule hai ki students sirf Open-Source ya legal APIs hi use karein. Faculty codebase check karti hai taaki company pe future mein koi copyright strike ya legal case na aaye.

reply_en: 🚀 The Solvex Pitch: Solvex-AI is a B2B platform that turns academic assignments into real-world industry solutions. We give companies dirt-cheap, high-quality tech built by mentored students, while turning students into industry-ready professionals before they even graduate!
reply_hi: 🚀 Solvex in 1 Line: Solvex-AI ek aisa bridge hai jo college assignments ko real industry solutions me badal deta hai. Companies ko sasta aur best tech milta hai, aur students graduate hone se pehle hi industry-ready aur financially independent ban jaate hain!

reply_en: 👨‍💻 Creators & Founders: The core vision of Solvex-AI was conceptualized by Praveen Nama. But a great vision needs a great team! It was brought to life by an incredible core team including Priyanshi Kumawat, Krishna Yadav, and Meenal Patwa.
reply_hi: 👨‍💻 Creators & Founders: Solvex-AI ka core vision Praveen Nama ka hai. Lekin ek akele se itna bada platform nahi banta! Isko real life mein lane ke liye ek solid team ne milkar kaam kiya hai jisme Priyanshi Kumawat, Krishna Yadav, aur Meenal Patwa shamil hain.

reply_en: 🤝 The Dream Team: Solvex-AI was built by an amazing group of talented minds! Praveen Nama led the project, working seamlessly alongside the brilliant core developers: Priyanshi Kumawat, Krishna Yadav, and Meenal Patwa.
reply_hi: 🤝 The Dream Team: Solvex-AI ko ek shaandaar team ne milkar banaya hai! Praveen Nama ne is project ko lead kiya hai, aur unke saath is power-packed team mein Priyanshi Kumawat, Krishna Yadav, aur Meenal Patwa shamil hain.
